review.summary: Correct ring6 fixed-center120-degree counterclockwise rotation to absolute+30-degree release. Its opening aligns with the lower-right coupling; only ring6 escapes left/down. All other eleven rings and links remain stationary. IQ90→95 and brief Good clear into the final partial-result hold.
review.visual_review: Six encoded frames at0,3.3,5.05,6.1,7.4,11.5 seconds compared with the selected native image and source plan. Full headline/footer retained, no extra ring removal or endcard.
review.native_style: Moving ring retains metallic copper shading using cross-sectional colors sampled from unobstructed source arcs. Fixed copper/bronze/wood rings keep their original source pixels. Small local release ticks and synchronized metallic sounds emphasize the one unlock.
review.audio_review: Exact mechanics narration generated with installed Samantha voice and mixed with original synthesized music, input/friction ticks, unlock click, release swoosh and brief chime. AAC stereo, non-silence and peak levels verified; audio was not independently listened to.
limitations: The moving ring uses a rigid reconstructed contour and sampled shading, so it is a local rendering approximation rather than an extracted3D mesh or original gameplay capture.
Hidden background/tutorial coverage and pointer cutout are locally reconstructed. Minor edge/patch differences remain at full size.
This is a presentation mockup, not a rebuilt Unity game.
